propositions: Bridge orchestration must be packaged as runner-neutral Python core and exposed through three public surfaces: library (rebar.bridge_run), CLI (rebar bridge run --profile), and MCP (write-gated bridge_run tool)
Runner accepts five named profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) and maps legacy MODE environment variable for backward compatibility
Wheel distribution must be available from all supported install paths: pip wheel, Homebrew wheel-backed environment, and MCP Registry/uvx without requiring repository-local scripts
Direct legacy reconcile callers retain published benign results (3/4/75); new provider runner translates legacy benign results to canonical 0 while preserving operational 1 and invalid-invocation 2
GitHub/Jenkins/GitLab provider wrappers remain thin and invoke only the installed rebar bridge run CLI, with schema validation and ShellCheck linting for embedded shell
Successful non-paused passes invoke strict delivery with run id, bot identity, and REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always; valid pause markers skip delivery and return success
